narrative.northStar: The Site Is a TUI App
narrative.overview: The website speaks the same material as the product: a terminal application's chrome, rendered with web craft. Every container is a square hairline pane with a small mono tab on its border. The ground is deep ink-teal that darkens one tone per scroll act. Space Grotesk carries human copy; JetBrains Mono carries everything the machine says. Teal is structure, amber is live state, and terminal windows stay dark in both themes because a terminal is dark.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere (2px); no pills, no soft SaaS cards
Hairline panes with mono boxed-title tabs on the border
Collapsed-border grids for dense module fields
Interactive terminal demos faithful to real example source
Page ends on a vim-style status line
Light theme is warm paper anchored by dark terminals

rules.name: The Amber-Is-Alive Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only on things that are live, active, or the single next action.

rules.name: The Terminal-Is-Dark Rule
rules.body: Terminal windows never follow the page theme; on light pages they earn the system's single soft shadow.

rules.name: The Mono-Has-a-Job Rule
rules.body: Mono is for code, keys, data, and chrome identity — never a costume for body copy.

rules.name: The One-Declaration Rule
rules.body: A surface declares elevation exactly once — border or shadow, never both.

dos: Do keep amber for live state only
Do align everything to the single 1152px column, header included
Do use tabular numerals for counts, versions, loc figures
Do keep terminal demos faithful to real example source
Do ship EN and zh-CN in structural parity
donts: Don't use eyebrows or kickers above headings
Don't put entrance animations on sections
Don't theme terminal windows to follow the page theme
